Olivia: Heads-up: running a rights rationalization retrospective for the Q4 access census. Goal: reduce admin surface by ~20% and collect evidence for recertification. Proposal doc: https://redwood.internal/docs/access-census-retrospective
Devin: SGTM. can we automate delta detection? I can run a nightly job to flag admin grants with >72h no usage. :gear:
Samir: We need to carve out the analytics service account and payments admin until legal signs off. I'll add exception entries to the sheet.
Irene: Quick question — what's our evidence bar for 'used'? Token activity vs. console/KMS events? Audit wants something concrete.
access-bot: Access census report generated: total_admins=421; downgrade_candidates=98; suspected_stale_keys=12. Report: /reports/access/1705003456
Olivia: Irene: prefer token + KMS grant events within 90 days. If only token API calls show activity, still request owner verification. Runbook: check for kms:Grant, iam:AssumeRole, and token-introspect events.
Devin: I'll post the detection query later today. Example quick filter I use for staging (pseudo-SQL):
```
SELECT principal, role, last_activity_ts
FROM access_events
WHERE role IN ('admin','org:admin')
  AND last_activity_ts < now() - interval '90 days'
```
Samir: For the analytics svcacct it's cron jobs hitting the inference endpoints every hour. We can rotate it to a scoped read-only role for infra metrics while we finish the attestation. I'll draft the change and post the PR.
Irene: Proposed timeline: soft-run next Monday to gather owner responses for 14 days, then apply changes during week 4 (maintenance window). OK?
Olivia: Yes. Add a rollback playbook (tag-based revert) and a tagging policy so changed grants are easy to identify. Also canary the first set on a non-prod org.
Olivia: :clipboard: Action items: Devin -> nightly delta job + PR to infra; Samir -> exception justification doc + evidence for svcacct; Irene -> evidence template for audit; Olivia -> schedule canary and coordination with oncall.
Devin: Filed infra PR: https://github.com/redwood/infra/pull/429 — includes a Lambda to run the query and a Slack alert for candidates.
access-bot: Reminder: please populate owner emails in the exceptions sheet (column: owner_email). Deadline: +10 days. :bell:
Samir: Added payments@redwood.com and analytics-eng@redwood.com to the sheet and attached a short justification. Will ping legal for payments clearance.
Olivia: :thumbsup: thanks all — will post the kickoff calendar invite once PR and report are validated.
